title: Text and fonts
summary: Control the font, size, weight, line spacing, alignment and decoration of text.

docs.title: MDN: Fundamental text and font styling

quiz.q: Why does `font-family: Arial, sans-serif;` list two values?
options: The second is a fallback if the first is not installed
quiz.explain: The browser tries fonts left to right and uses the first one available. End the list with a generic family such as `sans-serif`.

quiz.q: Centre the text of a paragraph.
quiz.explain: `text-align` accepts `left`, `right`, `center` and `justify`. Note the American spelling: `center`.

quiz.q: Which declaration removes the underline from links?
quiz.explain: Underlines come from `text-decoration`. Set it to `none` to remove it, or `underline` to add one.

quiz.q: A paragraph has `font-size: 20px` and `line-height: 1.5`. What is the line height in px?
quiz.explain: A unitless line-height multiplies the font size: 1.5 times 20px is 30px. Unitless values scale nicely with the text.

exercise.task:
Style the article text. Work in `index.html`.

- `h1`: `font-size` 32px, centred (`text-align: center`).
- `p`: `font-family` ending with the generic `sans-serif`, `font-size` 18px, `line-height` 1.5.
- `.lead`: `font-weight` bold.
- `a`: no underline (`text-decoration: none`).
hints: Each of these is a plain property: font-size, text-align, font-family, line-height, font-weight, text-decoration.
Write one rule per selector. A unitless line-height such as 1.5 is multiplied by the font size.

checks.name: The h1 is centred
checks.hint: Add text-align: center; to the h1 rule.

checks.name: Paragraphs have a line height of 27px (1.5 times 18px)
checks.hint: Add line-height: 1.5; to the p rule.

checks.name: Paragraphs list a sans-serif font family
checks.hint: Write font-family: Arial, sans-serif; (end with the generic sans-serif).
